correctness.rationale: For each finite N, Yang Thm 3.7 identifies formula denotations with all union-closed families F subset P(V) containing empty, V=2^N, for exactly the stated five lax team logics. Complement every member X subset V to V\X: F maps bijectively and inclusion-preservingly to intersection-closed families containing V, i.e. Moore families. Therefore the quotient poset is isomorphic and q_n=M_(2^n). Independent exhaustive enumeration of all set families on m<=4 yields M1=2,M2=7,M3=61,M4=2480, confirming q0=2,q1=7,q2=2480; the general mapping is an immediate De Morgan identity. The claimed asymptotic is inherited from classical log2 M_m~binom(m,floor(m/2)) and Stirling, not established by enumeration. The restriction to lax semantics/locality and fixed variable set matters.

OEIS A102896 already identifies Moore-family counts with union-closed set systems and provides 2,7,61,2480; A102897 records the standard leading logarithmic asymptotic. All new cardinalities/order identification follow by one De Morgan relabeling and m=2^n substitution. Neither absence of the words Moore family from Yang nor missing exact combined sentence establishes independence.
